Review what you did over a day or a week. The report helps when you write a weekly summary.

## CLI: gournal log

Show your entries in time order, grouped by day. The log covers today unless you choose a period. The --from and --to options override --yesterday, --week, and --month.

```text
gournal log [options]
```

### Options

| Option | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `-y, --yesterday` | Cover yesterday and today. |
| `-w, --week` | Cover the current week. |
| `-m, --month` | Cover the current month. |
| `--from <date>` | Only entries from this date (inclusive). Use a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp. |
| `--to <date>` | Only entries up to this date (inclusive). Use a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp. |
| `-p, --project <project>` | Only entries of this project. |
| `--repo <owner/name>` | Only entries of this repository (owner/name). |
| `-t, --tags <tags>` | Only entries that have all of these tags. Separate tags with commas. |

## MCP tool: get_work_log

Get a work log, grouped by day. It covers today unless you choose a period. The from and to options override yesterday, week, and month.

### Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `yesterday` | `boolean` | no | Cover yesterday and today. |
| `week` | `boolean` | no | Cover the current week. |
| `month` | `boolean` | no | Cover the current month. |
| `from` | `string` | no | Only entries from this date (inclusive). Use a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp. |
| `to` | `string` | no | Only entries up to this date (inclusive). Use a local day (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO timestamp. |
| `project` | `string` | no | Only entries of this project. |
| `repo` | `string` | no | Only entries of this repository (owner/name). |
| `tags` | `string[]` | no | Only entries that have all of these tags. |

### Output

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `title` | `string` | yes | Title of the period, for example Today (2026-11-15). |
| `start` | `string` | yes | Start of the period, as an ISO timestamp. |
| `end` | `string` | yes | End of the period, as an ISO timestamp. |
| `days` | `object[]` | yes | The days of the period, oldest first. |
| `days.date` | `string` | yes | Local day, as YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `days.entries` | [`Entry[]`](/docs/reference/output-shapes/#entry) | yes | Entries of this day, oldest first. |
| `count` | `number` | yes | Number of entries in the period. |
| `projectCount` | `number` | yes | Number of projects that have entries in the period. |
| `linkedActivity` | `object` | yes | GitHub activity that gournal linked to an entry in this report. The key is the entry id. |
| `linkedActivity.<key>` | [`Activity[]`](/docs/reference/output-shapes/#activity) | yes | Activity items linked to this entry. |
| `syncWarning` | `string \| null` | yes | A warning from the automatic GitHub sync, or null. The same warning is the last line of the text result. |

## Examples

### CLI

Show every entry of today in time order, with the project and tags of each entry.

```console
$ gournal log

Work Log: Today (2026-11-15)

  Sun Nov 15
    22:05 757FDB8A  Fix rounding error in invoice totals  [billing-api] #review
    22:19 M9S70F2G  Add keyboard focus styles to the invoice date picker  [billing-api] #ui
    22:33 D12ZERTC  Document the invoice export endpoint  [billing-api] #docs
    22:47 6G7W8GT1  Move the settings page to the new form components  [worker] #ui
    23:01 YHB4Y2E7  Document the retry policy for webhooks  [worker] #docs
    23:15 7XYDNPAQ  Review the queue backoff change  [worker] #review #ui
    23:29 ZY40X9DE  Cannot reproduce the failing webhook retry in staging  [billing-api] 
    23:43 48HE4S3P  Add a regression test for tax rounding  [billing-api] #review

  8 entries across 2 projects.
```
